{
  "name": "nerd-font",
  "displayName": "nerd-font",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Works out once whether a Nerd Font is installed, with a setting to force it on or off, so mods that draw Nerd Font glyphs know when to fall back",
  "author": {
    "name": "AH-Merii (AbdulHamid Merii)",
    "url": "https://github.com/AH-Merii"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/AH-Merii/claude-plugins/tree/main/plugins/nerd-font",
  "repository": "https://github.com/AH-Merii/claude-plugins",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "terminal",
    "tui",
    "nerd-font",
    "glyphs"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "glyphs": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nerd Font glyphs",
      "description": "auto: draw them when an installed font's family has \"Nerd Font\" in its name (fc-list). on or off: always or never, whatever is installed",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
